verdict.rationale: Helicone is an LLM observability and gateway platform, so CI-based evals with deployment gating is a fair axis for it. The pack never shows a CI eval runner, a CI integration, or pass/fail gating on eval results. The closest items are webhook-driven 'real-time evaluation' that scores production requests and a UI playground for prompt testing. Neither delivers running evals in a pipeline or blocking a deploy on their outcome.
